errors.text: The MgAlTiVFeCo ball-milled BCC starting powder was not identified.
Spark plasma sintering and the 1000 °C optimum were not reconstructed.
No density, hardness, oxidation, or corrosion outcomes were predicted.
The explicit 800–1000 °C operating boundaries given in the request were not used.
No falsifiable comparison of intermediate temperatures with the proposed optimum was designed.
